conviction_note: H1 FY27 is already out in outline (Q1 and Q2 sales growth above the 3-5% guide, gross margin above 45%, return on sales of 15% or more, net cash, no non-underlying costs; RNS 22 Jul and 1 Sep 2026), so the move sits in the full-year line. The 15% H1 return on sales against an undated two-analyst MarketScreener FY27 EBIT of GBP13.6m (about $18m) implies a cautious H2, which makes a third upgrade or a firmed 'significantly ahead' plausible. That bar is unsourced to a company statement, so the findings are capped small and p_up sits at 55. abs_move 6.5 reflects thin turnover ($138k/day), an intact tail (+8.4% on last year's interims, +24%/+38% on earlier updates) and a possible guidance change. The findings sum to +1.6 and the scaled number is +0.65; the gap is the sign uncertainty on a pre-released half and is intended.

Sign uncertain; this is where the move is.

bar: Company bar: H1 ROS 15%+, gross margin 45%+, sales growth above 3-5% (RNS 1 Sep 2026, https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/trading-statement/9747116). Street bar: one source only, an undated MarketScreener consensus (2 analysts) of FY27 net sales GBP133.4m, EBIT GBP13.58m, EPS GBP0.2192 (https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DIALIGHT-PLC-4004146/finances/). The pre-upgrade Edison consensus of 7 Jul 2026 was FY27 revenue $173.9m, PBT $11.9m, EPS 20.0c (https://www.edisongroup.com/research/first-phase-of-transformation-strategy-complete/BM-3653/). The post-upgrade street bar is not confirmed by two agreeing sources, so every finding is capped small.
session_check: bmo. The company's own 1 Sep 2026 RNS states 'The Group will report its interim results for the six months ending 30 September 2026 on 10 November 2026' (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/trading-statement/9747116). Every prior Dialight results RNS went out at 07:00 London (FY26 interims 11 Nov 2025 07:00, finals 23 Jun 2026 07:00; https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/DIA). The 6 Nov 2026 RNS puts the Investor Meet Company presentation on 13 Nov 10:00 GMT (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/investor-presentation-via-investor-meet-company/9862955), the same three-day lag as 2025 (results 11 Nov, IMC 14 Nov; https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/investor-presentation-via-investor-meet-company/9228623). So the date has not moved. The 07:00 time is inferred from the company's pattern and is not yet timestamped.
positioning_check: No disclosed net short position at or above 0.5% on the FCA aggregated register as of 2026-11-06 (baseline). anchor_covered is false: this is the truncation floor, not evidence that nobody is short, and there is no building or covering to read, so priced_lean_pct (+0.41) is essentially the run-up term. Long-side concentration is the visible positioning. Aberforth went from 15.61% to 23.79% on 21 Sep and to 24.90% on 9 Oct; the Wellcome Trust sold out of 8.53%; Schroders trimmed from 13.91% to 12.99% on 13 Oct. The EBT bought about 425k shares between 27 Jul and 28 Sep.

findings.finding: H1 FY27 at the guided 15%+ return on sales means roughly $12-13m+ of underlying operating profit in H1 alone (H1 FY26 was $5.5m on $86.4m revenue, FY26 full year $10.3m). Against an FY27 consensus EBIT of about GBP13.6m (~$18m), that leaves an implied H2 of only ~$5m, so the full-year outlook line is more likely to be firmed or raised again than cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance upgrades moved the stock +24.3% (28 Jan 2025 trading statement), +38.2% (Jun 2025 finals), +8.9% (22 Jul 2026 'ahead') and +3.6% on the window (1 Sep 2026 'significantly ahead'; intraday +7.6% per AJ Bell). The FY26 interims, which reiterated upgraded expectations, moved +8.4%. The Jun 2026 finals, with no new upgrade, fell 5.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has given back the September upgrade: 596p intraday on 1 Sep, 602p on 28 Sep, 520-538p now (-8.2% over 20 days, including an unexplained -6.7% on 19 Oct). If the market expected a further raise it would be trading at or above the post-upgrade high. The consensus is two analysts and undated, so the H2-implied arithmetic is probably not reflected in a refreshed street number. This is inference from a single-source bar and is capped accordingly.
findings.independence: H1 FY26 base and FY26 underlying operating profit come from the company's own documents: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/fy26-interim-results/9224933 and https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/final-results/9630717. Consensus is from https://uk.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/DIALIGHT-PLC-4004146/finances/. The pre-upgrade Edison PBT of $11.9m (https://www.edisongroup.com/research/first-phase-of-transformation-strategy-complete/BM-3653/) shows how low the starting bar was.

findings.finding: Dialight has moved from net bank debt of $10.2m (Sep 2025) to net cash (Jul 2026, still improving at 1 Sep). The FY26 report says the board is 'committed to returning excess funds to shareholders via future dividends or share repurchases', so a first interim dividend or buyback in this release is a possible new line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No capital return in the reaction history: no dividend for FY25 or FY26.
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing in the RNS flow has signalled a dividend, and the EBT purchase programme (about GBP2.3m of shares) is the only cash return seen so far. A priced-in dividend would show as press preview chatter, and none was found. Low probability; small size.
findings.independence: Net cash position stated in https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/correction-trading-statement-typographical-error/9682365. EBT buying in https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/dialight--dia/employee-benefit-trust-share-purchase/9803039.

findings.finding: Aberforth Partners lifted its holding from 15.61% to 23.79% (21 Sep 2026) and to 24.90% (9 Oct 2026), absorbing the Wellcome Trust's full 8.53% exit, while Schroders trimmed from 13.91% to 12.99% (13 Oct). The free float is concentrated with a value holder that was buying at roughly 550-575p after the September upgrade.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance in the reaction history.
findings.why_not_priced: The holdings RNS are public, and the price fell after them, so the support is at most partly priced. On a $138k/day stock, a concentrated long register makes a positive surprise harder to supply into. Small.

findings.finding: Hubbell's Q3 2026 (27 Oct) flagged continued softness in heavy industrial within Electrical Solutions, while the growth came from data centre, light industrial and utility. Heavy-industrial capex is Dialight Lighting's core end market, and FY26 already cited deferred capital projects, Middle East conflict and semiconductor and freight risk. That is a risk to the H2 Lighting outlook wording.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Oct 2025 trading statement held guidance on cautious Lighting sales, and the stock fell 2.8% intraday, 0.0% on the window. The Nov 2024 interims, on weak Lighting, fell 10.8%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a proxy from a counterparty-adjacent US peer, not Dialight's own customers, and Dialight said on 1 Sep that Q2 growth was continuing. Macro-to-company transmission is unproven, so the finding is small. The October drawdown may already partly reflect industrial caution.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive. That agrees with the small positive priced_lean (+0.41, a run-up term after the -8.2% 20-day drawdown) and cuts against the drawdown itself. Given the pre-released half and a single-source bar, p_up is held near 50.
language_note: The Holdings in Company RNS on Investegate (Aberforth to 24.9%, the Wellcome Trust's 8.53% exit, Schroders trimming) and the EBT purchase notices appeared in none of the English wire or preview copy found; no wire picked up the register shift.
Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: the trading statements are RNS, and AJ Bell/Alliance and Edison relayed them.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes median 9.0%) and 'too small about the move by a factor of three': abs_move_pct raised from 5.0 to 6.5, since a third FY27 upgrade is a live possibility on a thin name with an intact tail.
Guidance finding sized on the guidance scale: raised from +1.0 to +1.5, still capped because the post-upgrade bar is single-source and undated.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not to agree with': the Aberforth finding cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': kept the pre-released H1 lines out of findings, as already in the draft.
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': working capital added as a release line to check. No evidence of an inventory build, so no finding.
